page.layout: One title page, centred. From top to bottom: the title in several sizes (DOCTRINÆ / PHYSICAE / UNIVERSAE), the subtitle with a Greek word, the description, the author's name and place, a central ornament (engraving), a citation from Aristotle with a Greek quotation, and the imprint at the foot. No running head, page number or catchword.

main_text.l: Philosophorum publicis privatisque commentationibus excerpta, atq; ad veræ
Aristoteles Ethic. Nicom. l. I. c. 6.
Δόξειε δ' ἂν τις ἴσως βέλτιον εἶναι, καὶ ἀλεῖν, ἐπὶ σω[?]η-
ἐλάχ[?]ιστ[?] γε τ[?] ἀληθείας καὶ τὰ οἰκεῖα ἀναιρεῖν· ἄλλως
τε καὶ φιλοσόφους ὄντας. ἀμφοῖν γὰρ ὄντοιν φίλοιν,

page.notes: Central engraving: a square, diamond-shaped floral ornament with scrollwork and foliage, with pendant forms at the top and bottom. The top right corner has a handwritten mark (not transcribed). The Greek motto is partly cramped and smudged; the readings marked [?] are uncertain, and the line ends are hyphenated as printed. The imprint date is read as cIↄ Iↄ IIIC, i.e. MDIIIC, with the final letters uncertain; it may be a printing error for MDCIIIC or similar. The Greek word ὑποτύπωσις has an accent mark over the upsilon that is partly illegible.
